name: Powerful Ritual Effects
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-14: Twice in Steel
description: The effects of Hesla's profane ritual ripple outward through Deskari's Gullet. Physical tremors shake the cavern complex, while magical waves of energy affect those opposed to her actions.
disable: This hazard persists until Hesla's ritual is complete and her demonic forces defeated.
routine: (two actions) The ground shakes, and waves of demonic energy surge through the cavern. Each PC must make a save against tremors and a save against demonic energy. Enemy combatants must only make the Reflex save against tremors; they are immune to the Demonic Energy effects.

offensiveAbilities.name: The Ritual Continues
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Combat begins within Deskari's Gullet

Effect The Ritual Effects roll initiative. Each combat indicates how often this hazard triggers during that combat.

offensiveAbilities.name: Tremors
offensiveAbilities.description: Targets take (1d10+4) Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 27 Reflex Saving Throw save) as rocks fall from the ceiling. On a critical failure, the target falls Prone.

offensiveAbilities.name: Demonic Energy
offensiveAbilities.description: Targets take (1d10+4) Void Damage damage (Basic DC 27 Fortitude Saving Throw save). On a critical failure, the target is Sickened 1. Holy creatures treat their save as one degree worse for the purposes of the sickened condition only.
